args.body:
- Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers freight pricing this quarter, linking to their blog article and a free companion piece on their insights site.
- The article reports that spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- The companion piece finds that shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Freight Pricing Summary
